name: Feliz Penthouse
description:
Feliz Penthouse is a bright and welcoming penthouse located in the peaceful Sunny Golf urbanisation, within the prestigious Estepona Golf area. Surrounded by beautiful natural landscapes and golf courses, this newly furnished property offers the perfect setting for a relaxing holiday on the Costa del Sol.

The apartment comfortably accommodates up to 4 guests and features 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. One of its standout features is the exceptional outdoor space, including a spacious 30 m² private balcony and an impressive 70 m² private rooftop terrace, ideal for making the most of the Mediterranean lifestyle.

From both the balcony and rooftop terrace, guests can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the surrounding mountains, the golf course and the Mediterranean Sea, creating a truly unique setting. Thanks to its south-west orientation, the property benefits from abundant natural light throughout the day and spectacular sunsets in the evening.

The rooftop terrace is the perfect place to enjoy breakfast in the sunshine, unwind with a drink at sunset, practice yoga, work out outdoors or simply relax while taking in the breathtaking scenery and peaceful surroundings.

Inside, the apartment has been recently furnished throughout, creating a fresh, modern and comfortable atmosphere. For added convenience, it is equipped with both a washing machine and a dryer, making it an excellent choice for longer stays.

Guests also have access to a communal swimming pool within the urbanisation, providing the perfect place to cool off and relax after a day at the beach, exploring Estepona or enjoying a round of golf.

Ideally located just a short drive from Estepona's beaches, restaurants, shops and charming historic centre, Feliz Penthouse combines comfort, tranquillity and an excellent location, making it an ideal choice for families, couples and golf enthusiasts alike.

- Explore the Surroundings

Beyond the tranquillity of Estepona Golf, Feliz Penthouse is perfectly located for discovering some of Southern Spain's most iconic destinations.

• Relax on the beautiful beaches of the Costa del Sol

• Visit the picturesque white village of Casares

• Explore Marbella's charming Old Town, boutiques and beach clubs

• Discover Málaga's vibrant culture, museums and gastronomy

• Experience the breathtaking scenery of historic Ronda

• Visit Gibraltar and its famous Rock overlooking Africa

• Enjoy surfing and beach life in Tarifa

• Take a memorable day trip to Morocco from nearby ports

Please note that we welcome families and couples only, no groups under 30, and no hen or stag parties. Should you fall outside of this category but wish to book nonetheless, please send us an enquiry detailing a bit more about yourself and the group that you will be travelling with so we can request this for you.

Don’t forget to ask about our concierge service! We look forward to welcoming you.
